name: alla prima

menus.name: Dinner tasting course
menus.note: A single set course; contents and price change often. Wine pairing of 8 glasses ₩300,000, 5 glasses ₩230,000 or 3 glasses ₩150,000 (Krug ₩60,000 extra). About 2½ to 3 hours.

menus.name: Lunch tasting course
menus.note: Wine pairing of 5 glasses ₩220,000 or 3 glasses ₩130,000. About 1½ to 2 hours.

bookingOpens: Online through Catchtable (linked from the restaurant's website) or by phone. Bookings are required. Lunch starts at 12pm (last booking 12:30pm) and dinner at 6pm (last booking 7pm).
cancellation: Deposits are refunded in full only for cancellations at least three days ahead (two weeks for collaboration events and Christmas). If fewer guests come on the day, a no-show charge for the food may apply. Arriving more than 15 minutes late can count as a no-show.
groups: Groups of up to 8 sit in the private room only (6 to 8 guests, no room charge); call for 7 or more. The dining room can be hired for up to 22.
dressCode: Smart casual is requested. No slippers or strong perfume.
children: No children below middle-school age. There's no children's menu; call ahead about younger guests.
duration: About 1½ to 2 hours for lunch and 2½ to 3 hours for dinner.
byob: Up to two bottles per table (wine or sake), ₩100,000 corkage a bottle.
